description: Today, Lieutenant Governor Leslie Rutledge announced that her re-election campaign enters the final quarter of 2025 with nearly three quarters of a million dollars cash-on-hand. Rutledge raised $213,568 during Q3 of 2025.
paid_for_by: PAID FOR BY LESLIE RUTLEDGE FOR LT
title: RUTLEDGE CAMPAIGN: Nearly Three-Quarters of a Million Dollars Cash-on-Hand
